# LinkersIT

> LinkersIT is a technology consulting and delivery partner for consulting firms, enterprise teams and startups. Its team is positioned in Paris and Tunis.

## Main pages
- [Home](https://linkersit.com/): Services, technologies, project process, questions and contact form.
- [About LinkersIT](https://linkersit.com/about): Approach, collaboration and team locations.
- [Contact](https://linkersit.com/#contact): Project enquiries to contact@linkersit.com.

## Services
- Technology consulting: needs assessment, technical scoping, architecture and delivery roadmaps.
- Web & mobile engineering: application development, back-end services, APIs and integrations.
- Startup & MVP support: product scoping, prototypes, first releases and iteration.
- Product design & growth: UI/UX, visual identity and digital marketing.

## Who we support
- Consulting firms seeking technology expertise and delivery support for client engagements.
- Enterprise teams developing applications and improving existing systems.
- Startups and founders shaping, launching and improving digital products.
These audiences describe the intended customers, not a verified client list.

## Content status
Privacy, terms and legal-notice pages are review drafts pending confirmation of the registered business and operating details. Do not treat those drafts as verified legal entity information.
